arxiv-1710-03100.title: Theoretical analysis of Casimir and thermal Casimir effect in stationary space-time
arxiv-1710-03100.creator: Anwei Zhang
arxiv-1710-03100.description: Abstract We investigate Casimir effect as well as thermal Casimir effect for a pair of parallel perfectly plates placed in general stationary space-time background. It is found that the Casimir energy is influenced by the 00-component of metric and the corresponding quantity in dragging frame. We give a scheme to renormalize thermal correction to free energy in curved space-time.

arxiv-2108-00831.title: Projective Skip-Connections for Segmentation Along a Subset of Dimensions in Retinal OCT
arxiv-2108-00831.creator: Dmitrii Lachinov, Philipp Seeböck, Julia Mai, Felix Goldbach, Ursula Schmidt-Erfurth, Hrvoje Bogunovic
arxiv-2108-00831.description: Abstract In medical imaging, there are clinically relevant segmentation tasks where the output mask is a projection to a subset of input image dimensions. In this work, we propose a novel convolutional neural network architecture that can effectively learn to produce a lower-dimensional segmentation mask than the input image.

arxiv-2211-03361.title: Analysis of the arm-like structure in the outer disk of PDS 70
arxiv-2211-03361.creator: S. Juillard ,, V. Christiaens ,, O. Absil ,
arxiv-2211-03361.description: Abstract Context. Observing dynamical interactions between planets and disks is key to understanding their formation and evolution. Two protoplanets have recently been discovered within the PDS 70 protoplanetary disk, along with an arm-like structure toward the northwest of the star. Aims.

arxiv-2306-09986.title: Experimental storage of photonic polarization entanglement in a broadband loop-based quantum memory
arxiv-2306-09986.creator: C.J. Evans, C.M. Nunn, S.W.L. Cheng, J.D. Franson, T.B. Pittman
arxiv-2306-09986.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by C.J. Evans, C.M. Nunn, S.W.L. Cheng, J.D. Franson, T.B. Pittman. We describe an experiment in which one member of a polarization-entangled photon pair is stored in an active “loop and switch” type quantum memory device, while the other propagates through a passive optical delay line. A comparison of Bell’s inequality tests performed before and after the storage is used to investigate the ability of the memory to maintain entanglement, and demonstrate a rudimentary entanglement distribution protocol.

arxiv-2307-07624.title: On Barker-Larman Conjecture relative to a convex body with centrally symmetric sections
arxiv-2307-07624.creator: E. Morales-Amaya
arxiv-2307-07624.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by E. Morales-Amaya. Let K ⊂ ℝ n K\subset\mathbb{R}^{n} be a convex body, n ≥ 3 n\geq 3 . We say that K K satisfies the Barker-Larman condition if there exists a ball B ⊂ int ​ K B\subset\text{int}K such that for every supporting hyperplane Π \Pi of B B , the section Π ∩ K \Pi\cap K is a centrally symmetric set.

arxiv-2309-06724.title: Deep Nonparametric Convexified Filtering for Computational Photography, Image Synthesis and Adversarial Defense
arxiv-2309-06724.creator: Jianqiao Wangni
arxiv-2309-06724.description: Abstract We aim to provide a general framework of for computational photography that recovers the real scene from imperfect images, via the Deep Nonparametric Convexified Filtering (DNCF). It is consists of a nonparametric deep network to resemble the physical equations behind the image formation, such as denoising, super-resolution, inpainting, and flash.

arxiv-2311-00206.title: ChatGPT-Powered Hierarchical Comparisons for Image Classification
arxiv-2311-00206.creator: Zhiyuan Ren, Yiyang Su, Xiaoming Liu
arxiv-2311-00206.description: Abstract The zero-shot open-vocabulary setting poses challenges for conventional image classification. Vision-language models pretrained on image-text pairs like CLIP offer a solution based on comparing image and class label embeddings. Incorporating class-specific knowledge provided by large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT in descriptions can further enhance CLIP’s accuracy.

arxiv-2504-00707.title: Interleaved Multitask Learning with Energy Modulated Learning Progress
arxiv-2504-00707.creator: Hanne Say, Suzan Ece Ada, Emre Ugur, Minoru Asada, Erhan Oztop
arxiv-2504-00707.description: Abstract As humans learn new skills and apply their existing knowledge while maintaining previously learned information, ‘continual learning’ in machine learning aims to incorporate new data while retaining and utilizing past knowledge. However, existing machine learning methods often does not mimic human learning where tasks are intermixed due to individual preferences and environmental conditions.

arxiv-2506-15563.title: Control and Realism: Best of Both Worlds in Layout-to-Image without Training
arxiv-2506-15563.creator: Bonan Li, Yinhan Hu, Songhua Liu, Xinchao Wang
arxiv-2506-15563.description: Abstract Layout-to-Image generation aims to create complex scenes with precise control over the placement and arrangement of subjects. Existing works have demonstrated that pre-trained Text-to-Image diffusion models can achieve this goal without training on any specific data; however, they often face challenges with imprecise localization and unrealistic artifacts. Focusing on these drawbacks, we propose a novel training-free method, WinWinLay .

arxiv-2510-21345.title: α \alpha -LoRA: Effective Fine-Tuning via Base Model Rescaling
arxiv-2510-21345.creator: Aymane El FirdoussiMLO, EPFLEl Mahdi ChaytiMLO, EPFL, Mohamed El Amine SeddikTII, UAEMartin JaggiMLO, EPFL
arxiv-2510-21345.description: Abstract Fine-tuning has proven to be highly effective in adapting pre-trained models to perform better on new desired tasks with minimal data samples. Among the most widely used approaches are reparameterization methods, which update a target module by augmenting its frozen weight matrix with an additional trainable weight matrix.

plos-pone-0001859.title: Genomics of Signaling Crosstalk of Estrogen Receptor α in Breast Cancer Cells
plos-pone-0001859.creator: Peter Dudek, Didier Picard
plos-pone-0001859.description: PLOS ONE research article. The estrogen receptor α (ERα) is a ligand-regulated transcription factor. However, a wide variety of other extracellular signals can activate ERα in the absence of estrogen. The impact of these alternate modes of activation on gene expression profiles has not been characterized.

pmc-10697007.title: A Systematic Review of Experimental Studies on the Impact of Empowerment-Based Interventions on Child and Parent Outcomes in the Pediatric Oncology Setting
pmc-10697007.creator: Ikeu Nurhidayah, Nani Nurhaeni, Allenidekania Allenidekania, Dewi Gayatri
pmc-10697007.description: BackgroundCancer has an impact not only on children but also on parents. Parents play the most crucial role in cancer’s symptom control and management. However, as the primary caretakers, parents are frequently unprepared or engage in inappropriate behavior when caring for their children. Increasing parents’ role through empowerment is critical in pediatric cancer care.

pmc-10753237.title: IgG4-related disease involving coronary and pulmonary arteries: a case report and literature review
pmc-10753237.creator: Jin Cao, Zhaowen Yang
pmc-10753237.description: BackgroundIgG4-related disease (IgG4-RD) is an inflammation-mediated autoimmune disease characterized by infiltration of IgG4 plasma cells in target organs, storiform fibrosis and obliterative phlebitis, accompanied by or without elevated serum IgG4 concentrations. Multiple sites can be involved, including large vessels. Coronary and pulmonary arteries are less involved, while simultaneous involvement of coronary and pulmonary arteries is less reported.

pmc-11075026.title: Comparing Capitonnage and Uncapitonnage Techniques for Pulmonary Hydatid Cysts: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
pmc-11075026.creator: Yener Aydın, Kamber Kasalı, Ali Bilal Ulaş, Ayşenur Dostbil, İlker İnce, Atilla Eroğlu
pmc-11075026.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Surgery is the primary treatment for pulmonary hydatid cysts. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to compare the results of capitonnage and uncapitonnage techniques for the surgery of pulmonary hydatid cysts. Descriptive Boolean queries were used to search PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science for articles published up to June 2022 to evaluate the outcomes of pulmonary hydatid cysts in terms of mortality, postoperative complications, and hospital stay. A total of 12 studies were included.

pmc-11643883.title: Virus Removal from Real Wastewater as an Environmental Management Approach
pmc-11643883.creator: João Gomes, Eva Domingues, Danilo Frasson, Rui C. Martins, Ana Miguel Matos
pmc-11643883.description: The increased presence of resistant microorganisms in water promotes the need for supplementary measures to mitigate the water source’s contamination. Traditional treatments are inefficient in wastewater management at removing some emerging contaminants. Corbicula fluminea, an invasive species, can be used in the treatment due to their resistance and biofiltration capacity, working as a pest management strategy.

pmc-12454305.title: Comparison between national and PAHO criteria for assessing the nutritional profile of foods intended for children aged 0–3 years marketed in Lima, Peru
pmc-12454305.creator: Adolfo Aramburu, Jackeline Lizet Chupica-Leon, Beatriz Quispe-Quille, Julie Mariaca, Patricia Velarde-Delgado, Gilmer Solis-Sanchez, Bladimir Morales-Cahuancama, Fernando Bravo-Rebatta, María Elena Ugaz, Fredy Polo-Campos
pmc-12454305.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionThe rising consumption of industrialized infant foods and breastmilk substitutes during early childhood has raised concerns due to their suboptimal nutritional composition, which may contribute to the development of risk factors for non-communicable diseases.

pmc-12617100.title: OA2020. Violence against healthcare workers in Georgia: A comparative study
pmc-12617100.creator: N Pitskhelauri, M Kareli, N Chikhladze
pmc-12617100.description: BackgroundWorkplace violence (WPV) affects all worker groups, with healthcare workers (HWs) being particularly vulnerable. Globally, around 38% of HWs experience physical assaults, with even higher rates of verbal abuse. WPV undermines their safety, well-being, and job performance, leading to reduced quality of patient care.

pmc-13297714.title: Hybrid Code Index Modulation Based on Multi-Carrier Differential Chaos Shift Keying
pmc-13297714.creator: Xibei Yu, Chunyan Song
pmc-13297714.description: A hybrid code index modulation based on multi-carrier differential chaos shift keying (DCSK), referred to as HCIM MC-DCSK, is proposed in this paper. In the proposed system, multiple data-bearing information signals are transmitted simultaneously with one reference signal. The number of separate physical channels required for data transmission is M + 1, where M is the number of subcarriers.

pmc-13331119.title: Conservative treatments for chronic non-specific low back pain: time course network meta-analysis
pmc-13331119.creator: Daniel L Belavý, Tobias Saueressig, Nitin Kumar Arora, Arun Prasad Balasundaram, Xiaolong Chen, Ashish D Diwan, Jon J Ford, Andrew J Hahne, Svenja Kaczorowski, Clint T Miller, Niamh L Mundell, Hugo Pedder, Tim Schleimer, Scott D Tagliaferri, Florian Teichert, Xiaohui Zhao, Patrick J Owen
pmc-13331119.description: ObjectiveTo examine the efficacy of conservative (non-surgical) treatments, usual care, and no treatment for chronic radicular and non-specific back pain.DesignTime course network meta-analysis.Data sourcesSix electronic databases (Medline, SPORTDiscus, CINAHL, PsycINFO, Embase, and CENTRAL), searched from inception to 24 July 2020, and 302 previous systematic reviews.

pmc-13398828.title: Investigando o Papel Causal das Citocinas Inflamatórias no Desenvolvimento de Doenças Cardiovasculares, Renais e Metabólicas
pmc-13398828.creator: Mengjin Hu, Zhaoting Gong, Xiaosong Li, Chunlin Yin, Mengjin Hu, Zhaoting Gong, Xiaosong Li, Chunlin Yin
pmc-13398828.description: ResumoFundamento Estudos observacionais têm relacionado citocinas inflamatórias a distúrbios cardiometabólicos; no entanto, ainda não está claro se essas associações refletem efeitos causais em sistemas orgânicos interconectados.Objetivos Este estudo de randomização mendeliana (RM) investiga a causalidade entre 91 citocinas inflamatórias e disfunção multiorgânica nos sistemas cardiovascular, renal e metabólico na era da síndrome cardiovascular-renal-metabólica (CKM).

[FR Doc No: 98-9132] ======================================================================= ----------------------------------------------------------------------- DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION [Docket 37554] Notice of Order Adjusting the Standard Foreign Fare Level Index Section 41509(e) of Title 49 of the United States Code requires that the Department, as successor to the Civil Aeronautics Board, establish a Standard Foreign Fare Level (SFFL) by adjusting the SFFL base periodically.

uslaw-usc-t10-s443.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part I (Organization And General Military Powers); Chapter 22 (National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency); Subchapter I (Missions And Authority). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Use of Appropriated Funds.— The Director of the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency may use appropriated funds available to the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency to provide foreign countries, regional organizations with defense or security components.
